filename: PIXAL_ A Physics-Informed Explainable Machine Learning Architecture for Greenland Ice Albedo Modeling.pdf
title: PIXAL: A Physics-Informed Explainable Machine Learning Architecture for Greenland Ice Albedo Modeling
code_availability: The MAR code and output are available from ftp://ftp.climato.be/fettweis/MARv3.12. The code used to analyze the model and satellite data is available upon request from the corresponding author
testbed_rationale: The study creates a 22-year daily gridded dataset pairing regional climate model (MAR) features with satellite-derived (MODIS) bare ice albedo over southwest Greenland, well suited for training and evaluating scientific ML parameterizations of ice albedo.
pain_points: Analysis and machine learning code are only available upon request from the corresponding author.
Input MAR features may carry biases caused by MAR's inaccurate native ice albedo parameterization (feedback error propagation).
Offline parameterization: model was not yet coupled online into MAR or Earth system models.
Lack of direct representation of light-absorbing constituents (algal blooms, black carbon, mineral dust) and related positive feedbacks.
Potential out-of-distribution generalization issues for surface elevation under future warming as bare ice expands into higher elevations.
extraction_notes: The preprint date is given as 17 February 2026 on EGUsphere, with DOI registered under 2025 (egusphere-2025-6143). Symbolic regression via PySR and Random Forest were tested as alternative architectures to XGBoost.
